items.title: Reggie Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 22, 2018
items.q: You know Maynard lived with Timothy Leary.

ctx.x: [scats] Then when it comes down it’s minor. It’s on your website and it’s called “Chala Nata”

Oh “Chala Nata.” So that’s not my composition. But that is from my second record called “One for Miles One for Maynard” — two of my biggest influences. Miles, purely as a listener I was influenced and he was an idol of mine, and of course Maynard being my boss and somebody influencing me on a daily basis. Maynard loved to talk about India. And Maynard during a certain period of his life, his seventies, sixties I think it started. And a lot of people don’t know this about Maynard. You know Maynard lived with…
